info.title: Dynamic Form Builder API
info.description:
Dynamic Form Builder & Response Management API.

**Authenticate:** `POST /api/auth/login` (email as `username`) -> click **Authorize** and paste the token.
Default admin is seeded from `ADMIN_EMAIL` / `ADMIN_PASSWORD`.

post.description: OAuth2 password flow: send `username` (the email) and `password` as form fields.

schema.title: Response List Users Api Users Get

get.description: Admins see every form, users see the forms they own.

schema.title: Response List Forms Api Forms Get

get.description: Active forms the caller can fill in (public forms, plus all active forms when logged in).

schema.title: Response Available Forms Api Forms Available Get

patch.description: Enable / disable a form. Disabled forms reject new submissions.

get.description: Schema used by the fill-in page. Public forms need no login; others require authentication.

post.description: Submit answers keyed by field id. Anonymous submission is allowed only for public forms.

schema.title: Response My Responses Api Me Responses Get

put.description: Admins and form owners can always edit. Submitters can edit their own response if the form allows it.

get.description: Audit trail (creation + every edit with old/new values) for one response.

schema.title: Response Response History Api Responses  Response Id  History Get

get.description: Admins see everything. Users see their own actions plus activity on forms they own.

post.description: Upload an attachment for a File Upload field. Returns an id to send in the submission.

get.description: Download responses (honouring the same filters as the list endpoint) as Excel or PDF.

post.description: Queue the export on a Celery worker (for large forms). Poll the returned task id.
